paragraphs: Naḥum, R. Abbahu's attendant. R. Abbahu leaned on his shoulder, and he asked him about a dispute, etc., followed by an anonymous ruling, etc., Yevamot 4 (42b–43a). Yuḥasin, citing R.Sh.G. [רש״ג; provisionally Rav Sherira Gaon], writes: Naḥum, Abbahu's attendant, asked his teacher in Eruvin about an anonymous Mishnah and a dispute in a baraita. He answered, 'Rabbi did not teach it; where did R. Ḥiyya obtain it?' End of quotation. It is not in Eruvin but Yevamot, in a different wording, as above.
